description: Remove transport fallbacks that hide missing local callable evidence. For compiler-owned callable resolutions, capture demand must come from the resolved executable context's input_demands and boundary return shape must come from the resolved executable return evidence. Missing local resolution/context is a test failure, not a boundary_runtime_demand or type-return fallback. Preserve an explicit path only for genuinely opaque external callable contracts that have no compiler-owned target. Worked examples: suspend continuation captures reducer structurally, tuple callable returns publish recursive boundary contracts, opaque external callable inputs still publish an explicit boundary.
title: Transport authority: delete local capture and return fallbacks
